data.name: Extension_Description
data.value: F# Interactive language kernel extension for Verso notebooks.
data.comment: What this extension is, shown wherever extensions are listed.

data.name: Formatter_Description
data.value: Formats F# types as rich HTML tables and styled output.
data.comment: What this formatter does, shown wherever extensions are listed.

data.name: Import_Description
data.value: Converts Polyglot Notebooks F# patterns to Verso F# cells on Jupyter import.
data.comment: What this import hook does, shown wherever extensions are listed.

data.name: Kernel_Description
data.value: F# language kernel powered by FSharp.Compiler.Service.
data.comment: What the F# kernel is, shown wherever kernels are listed. FSharp.Compiler.Service is the name of the library and stays as written.

data.name: Kernel_InstalledPackages
data.value: Installed Packages
data.comment: Heading above the list of packages a cell installed. Keep it short; it sits above a list.

data.name: NuGet_DownloadFailed
data.value: Failed to download package '{0}' v{1} from nuget.org.
data.comment: {0} is a package name and {1} a version number. nuget.org is an address and stays as written.

data.name: NuGet_DownloadUnreachable
data.value: Unable to download package '{0}' v{1}. Check your network connection and try again. ({2}: {3})
data.comment: {0} is a package name, {1} a version number, {2} the kind of failure and {3} its message. The last two arrive in English.

data.name: NuGet_PackageNotFound
data.value: Package '{0}'{1} was not found on any configured source. Sources tried: {2}
data.comment: {0} is a package name, {1} is either empty or a version written as ' v1.2.3', and {2} is a comma-separated list of addresses.

data.name: NuGet_PackageNotFound_LastError
data.value: Last error: {0}: {1}
data.comment: Added to the end of the message above when a source answered with a failure. It opens with a space because it follows a full stop. {0} is the kind of failure and {1} its message, both of which arrive in English.

data.name: Run_CompilationError
data.value: Compilation error
data.comment: Shown in place of the compiler's own message when it would not compile and said nothing about why.

data.name: Run_OutOfMemory
data.value: Out of memory. The computation exceeded available memory. Consider restarting the kernel.
data.comment: A cell asked for more memory than there was. Shown as the cell's error.

data.name: Run_StackOverflow
data.value: Stack overflow. The computation exceeded the stack size limit. Consider restarting the kernel.
data.comment: A cell recursed too deeply. Shown as the cell's error.

data.name: Setting_LangVersion_Description
data.value: F# language version for the session.
data.comment: What the setting above does.

data.name: Setting_LangVersion_Label
data.value: Language Version
data.comment: Name of a setting. Keep it short.

data.name: Setting_MaxCollectionDisplay_Description
data.value: Maximum number of collection elements to display in formatted output.
data.comment: What the setting above does.

data.name: Setting_MaxCollectionDisplay_Label
data.value: Max Collection Display
data.comment: Name of a setting. Keep it short.

data.name: Setting_PublishPrivateBindings_Description
data.value: Whether to publish underscore-prefixed bindings to the variable store.
data.comment: What the setting above does. A binding whose name starts with an underscore is F#'s way of marking it private.

data.name: Setting_PublishPrivateBindings_Label
data.value: Publish Private Bindings
data.comment: Name of a setting. Keep it short.

data.name: Setting_WarningLevel_Description
data.value: F# compiler warning level (0–5).
data.comment: What the setting above does. The range is a pair of numbers and stays as written.

data.name: Setting_WarningLevel_Label
data.value: Warning Level
data.comment: Name of a setting, shown in the settings panel. Keep it short; it sits on one line beside a field.
